### Thanks for contributing, make sure you address all the checklists (for details on how see [development documentation](https://pipx.pypa.io/latest/contributing.html))

- [ ] ran the linter to address style issues (`pre-commit run --all-files`)

- [ ] wrote descriptive pull request text

- [ ] ensured there are test(s) validating the fix

- [ ] added news fragment in `changelog.d/` folder (choose a type: `feature`, `bugfix`, `doc`, `removal`, or `misc`)

- [ ] updated/extended the documentation

- [ ] ran tests on Python 3.11 and 3.15 (`tox run -e 3.11,3.15`)

- [ ] linked upstream issues beside any temporary interpreter overrides

- [ ] kept the PR in draft until CI passes
